security_problem: AIP visor-session used to collapse a verified actor chain to spoofable --client-id / --session-id strings. tools/call arguments must never become VerifiedActorContext. Missing or expired process-start context, and a read-only delegated scope, must not authorize write.
required_behavior: With settings.require_verified_actor (or tool required_scopes), interceptAndModify forwards user1→planner→coding-agent write when a sealed process-start VerifiedActorContext has write scope; orphan write and read-only-scope write return denied and a named mock observer records no tools/call; argument _verified_actor cannot authorize; omitting the setting forwards the same write without context.
failure_behavior: Missing, expired, or structurally invalid process-start context denies before relay. Scope is exact-match. MCP tools/call identity fields are stripped and ignored. This is not host isolation or complete mediation.
